Problem Statement:
Given a string, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters. 
Input Description:
The input consists of a string S, where its length |S| is at most 1000. 
Output Description:
The output is an integer representing the length of the longest substring without repeating characters. 
Sample Input:
abcabcccdd 
Sample Output:
3
